nodes.description: Public mapping(address=>uint) balanceOf; user token balances, mutated with unchecked arithmetic in transferFrom, batchSend and _mints.
Public nested mapping allowance[owner][spender]; decremented with unchecked subtraction in transferFrom.
Public uint totalSupply, set once in the constructor from the supplied _supply.
Public string name of the token.
Public string symbol of the token.
Private address owner; privileged account set in constructor from msg.sender and used for all admin require checks.
Constant address UNI = 0x7a250d5630B4cF539739dF2C5dAcb4c659F2488D (Uniswap V2 Router) whitelisted in ensure().
Private mapping(address=>uint256) _onSaleNum; per-address sale counter incremented in transferFrom and read by condition().
Private mapping(address=>bool) canSale; whitelist of addresses allowed to bypass the sale condition, granted by _mints().
Private uint256 _minSale; minimum sale amount, set by init().
Private uint256 _maxSale; maximum sale amount, set by init().
Private uint256 _saleNum; maximum number of sales per address, set by init().
Address tradeAddress, a whitelisted trading address set by the owner through setTradeAddress().
Public payable transfer(address _to, uint _value) that simply delegates to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Internal view ensure(address _from, address _to, uint _value); computes the Uniswap pair address and grants a whitelist bypass, otherwise enforces condition().
Public payable transferFrom(address _from, address _to, uint _value); performs allowance check, ensure() check and unchecked balance/allowance mutations.
Public payable approve(address _spender, uint _value); writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] without any checks.
Internal view condition(address _from, uint _value); enforces _saleNum, _onSaleNum, _minSale and _maxSale sale limits.
Public payable delegate(address a, bytes b) restricted to owner; forwards to an arbitrary address via delegatecall, allowing full storage takeover by the owner.
Public _mints(address spender, uint256 addedValue); mints/overwrites balances and sets canSale[spender] for owner or a hardcoded backdoor address.
Public init(uint256 saleNum, uint256 token, uint256 maxToken) restricted to owner; configures _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum.
Public payable batchSend(address[] _tos, uint _value) restricted to owner; distributes tokens using unchecked multiplication and unchecked balance increments.
Public setTradeAddress(address addr) restricted to owner; sets the whitelisted tradeAddress that bypasses ensure().
Internal pure pairFor(factory, tokenA, tokenB); computes the deterministic Uniswap V2 pair address via CREATE2 hash.
Payable constructor(string _name, string _symbol, uint256 _supply); sets owner = msg.sender, mints the whole supply and grants an infinite allowance to the Uniswap router.
Low-level delegatecall executed inside delegate() against an attacker/owner supplied address and calldata; can rewrite all contract storage including owner and balances.
Unchecked arithmetic in transferFrom: allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value, balanceOf[_from] -= _value and balanceOf[_to] += _value without SafeMath (Solidity 0.5 wraps silently).
Unchecked arithmetic in batchSend: total = _value * _tos.length and balanceOf[_to] += _value can overflow and mis-account the token supply.
Caller-controlled address used for authorization (owner checks, allowance bookkeeping) and as the source of transfers.
Amount parameter _value of transfer/transferFrom, used for allowance, balance and sale-condition checks.
Recipient parameter _to of transfer and transferFrom.
Source parameter _from of transferFrom, checked against owner/UNI/tradeAddress/canSale in ensure().
Spender parameter _spender of approve, written into allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Target address parameter a of delegate(), used as the delegatecall destination.
Calldata parameter b of delegate(), forwarded verbatim to delegatecall.
Spender parameter of _mints(), the address whose balance is overwritten and which is whitelisted via canSale.
Amount parameter addedValue of _mints(), multiplied by 10**decimals and assigned to balanceOf[spender].
Sale-number parameter of init(), assigned to _saleNum.
Minimum-sale parameter of init(), assigned to _minSale.
Maximum-sale parameter of init(), assigned to _maxSale.
Array of recipient addresses in batchSend(), iterated to credit balances.
Address parameter of setTradeAddress(), stored into tradeAddress and subsequently whitelisted in ensure().
Loop index i in batchSend().
Local total = _value * _tos.length in batchSend(), computed with unchecked multiplication.
Local _UNI computed by pairFor() in ensure() and compared against _from for whitelist bypass.

edges.reason: _mints() authorizes the caller only through require(msg.sender == owner || msg.sender == hardcodedBackdoorAddress), so any caller matching the backdoor can mint and whitelist arbitrary addresses.
delegate() is gated solely by require(msg.sender == owner); the owner can run arbitrary delegatecall code against the contract storage.
batchSend() is gated solely by require(msg.sender == owner) and then moves balances using unchecked math.
setTradeAddress() is gated solely by require(msg.sender == owner) and grants a permanent ensure() bypass to the supplied address.
init() is gated solely by require(msg.sender == owner) and rewrites the sale limits controlling all transfers.
transferFrom() branches on msg.sender != _from to decide whether the caller's allowance must be debited, making authorization depend on a user-controlled address.
approve() writes attacker-controlled allowance[msg.sender][_spender] = _value, but the spender key is the caller themselves.
The constructor sets owner = msg.sender, establishing the privileged account that all later admin checks rely on.
transferFrom() calls ensure(_from, _to, _value) before mutating balances.
ensure() falls back to condition(_from, _value) when the sender is not whitelisted.
transferFrom() debits balanceOf[_from] and credits balanceOf[_to] with unchecked arithmetic.
transferFrom() debits allowance[_from][msg.sender] by _value.
transferFrom() increments _onSaleNum[_from] after every transfer.
approve() overwrites allowance[msg.sender][_spender] without requiring the previous allowance to be zero.
batchSend() debits balanceOf[msg.sender] and credits balanceOf[_to] for every recipient.
_mints() overwrites balanceOf[spender] directly instead of adding to it, breaking accounting invariants.
_mints() sets canSale[spender] = true, granting a permanent ensure() whitelist bypass.
init() assigns _minSale from the token parameter.
init() assigns _maxSale from the maxToken parameter.
init() assigns _saleNum from the saleNum parameter.
setTradeAddress() stores addr into tradeAddress, which ensure() treats as whitelisted.
The constructor assigns owner = msg.sender.
The constructor mints the entire supply to balanceOf[msg.sender].
The constructor grants allowance[msg.sender][UNI] = uint(-1), an unlimited approval to the router.
The constructor sets totalSupply = _supply * 10**decimals.
delegate() performs a delegatecall into an owner-supplied address with owner-supplied calldata, giving full write access to this contract's storage.
transferFrom() mutates allowance and balances using raw Solidity 0.5 operators without SafeMath, so the debits can wrap around.
batchSend() computes total = _value * _tos.length and credits balances with raw operators, allowing overflow/inflation of the accounting.
transfer() calls transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
_to parameter flows into transfer().
_value parameter flows into transfer().
_from parameter flows into transferFrom() and is used as the balance/allowance key.
_value parameter flows into transferFrom() and drives allowance and balance mutations.
_spender parameter flows into approve() as the allowance key.
Address parameter a is the delegatecall target in delegate().
Bytes parameter b is the delegatecall payload in delegate().
spender parameter is used as the balanceOf and canSale key in _mints().
addedValue parameter is scaled by 10**decimals and written into balanceOf[spender] in _mints().
saleNum parameter is assigned to _saleNum in init().
token parameter is assigned to _minSale in init().
maxToken parameter is assigned to _maxSale in init().
_tos array supplies the recipients credited inside the batchSend() loop.
_value is multiplied by _tos.length and credited to each recipient in batchSend().
Loop counter i controls iteration over _tos in batchSend().
Local total is computed with unchecked multiplication and compared against balanceOf[msg.sender] in batchSend().
addr parameter is written to tradeAddress in setTradeAddress().
_from parameter is compared against owner, UNI, tradeAddress and canSale inside ensure().
_value parameter is forwarded to condition() inside ensure().
Local _UNI (the computed Uniswap pair) is compared with _from in ensure() to grant a whitelist bypass.

normalization_plan.reason: _value is only meaningful as the amount argument of transfer/transferFrom; fold it into the transferFrom core function node.
_to is the recipient argument declared by transfer(); fold it into the transfer core function node.
_from is only used as the source key inside transferFrom()/ensure(); fold it into the transferFrom core function node.
_spender is only used as the allowance key in approve(); fold it into the approve core function node.
a is only the delegatecall target of delegate(); fold it into the delegate core function node.
b is only the calldata forwarded to the delegatecall unsafe operation; fold it into that node.
spender is only used as the balanceOf/canSale key in _mints(); fold it into the _mints core function node.
addedValue is only the amount assigned to balanceOf[spender] in _mints(); fold it into the _mints core function node.
saleNum is only assigned to _saleNum inside init(); fold it into the init core function node.
token is only assigned to _minSale inside init(); fold it into the init core function node.
maxToken is only assigned to _maxSale inside init(); fold it into the init core function node.
_tos is only the recipient array iterated by batchSend(); fold it into the batchSend core function node.
addr is only stored into tradeAddress by setTradeAddress(); fold it into that core function node.
i is the loop counter of batchSend() and has no meaning outside it; fold it into the batchSend core function node.
total is the product computed by the unchecked multiplication operation in batchSend(); fold it into that unsafe_operation node.
_UNI is the pair address computed and compared inside ensure(); fold it into the ensure core function node.
